page.overview:
What is Elio?

Elio is a film produced by Pixar, released in theaters on June 20, 2025. The film is Pixar’s twenty-ninth feature-length film.

Archival recordings of Dr. Carl Sagan is used throughout the film.

On September 9, 2022, during the 2022 D23 Expo Presentation, Pixar announced a new original film titled Elio, with Adrian Molina directing and Mary Alice Drumm producing. It marks Molina as the sole directional debut of the film. That same day, America Ferrera and Yonas Kibreab were announced to have been cast in the leading voice roles of Olga Solis and Elio, respectively.

In October 2023, Disney announced it was delaying the release of Elio from March 1, 2024 to June 13, 2025, due to the 2023 actors strike.
